title: OpenLSR-X: A Python Framework for 2D-to-3D Orthogonal Super-Resolution and Petrophysical Validation in X-Ray Computed Tomography
description: Open-source PyTorch and PyTorch Lightning framework for 2D/2.5D-to-3D super-resolution (SwinIR, RRDB/RaGAN, SRGAN, SR3DResNet, and cell-centered 3-Axis Orthogonal Fourier Fusion) and quantitative petrophysical and diffusive transport validation of porous-media and synchrotron X-ray computed tomography (XCT) volumes.
